name: RetreatForge
tagline: The operating system for company offsites that actually pay off.
positioning: RetreatForge turns the chaos of planning a team offsite into one repeatable, budgeted, ROI-tracked workflow built for owner-operators.

hero.h1: Offsites, run like a supply chain.
hero.sub: RetreatForge gives SMB owner-operators one system to scope venues, lock budgets, assign owners, and prove ROI on every company offsite — no spreadsheet graveyard required.

features.title: Venue pipeline
features.description: Compare vetted venues by headcount, drive time, and per-head cost. Lock a hold, generate the contract, and route it for signature in one thread.

features.title: Budget ledger
features.description: Every line item — travel, catering, facilitation — ties to a cap you set. Overages flag before they clear, not after the offsite is over.

features.title: Owner assignments
features.description: Turn the agenda into accountable tasks. Each session, meal, and transfer has a named owner and a deadline your team can see.

features.title: ROI report
features.description: Auto-build a one-page recap: spend per attendee, attendance, survey scores, and follow-up actions your board can actually read.

features.title: Logistics timeline
features.description: Flights, ground transfers, and check-ins map to a single hour-by-hour run sheet the whole crew can pull up offline.

features.title: Approval controls
features.description: Set who signs off at which dollar threshold. Requests route, escalate, and log — so nothing gets booked on a whim.

testimonials.quote: We used to run our annual offsite off four spreadsheets and a group text. RetreatForge cut planning from six weeks to nine days and kept us $11k under budget.
testimonials.name: Danielle Portmann

testimonials.quote: The ROI report alone justified the seats. I finally walked into a partner meeting with a real number on what our leadership retreat delivered.
testimonials.name: Marcus Ojеda

testimonials.quote: Assigning owners to every session stopped the day-of scramble. Our 40-person offsite ran on the run sheet, not on me answering texts.
testimonials.name: Priya Raghunathan
